title: Understanding Diffusion Objectives as the ELBO with Simple Data Augmentation
tldr_zh: 所有常用 diffusion/FM 目标是按噪声级加权的 ELBO 积分，权重单调时等于加噪增广下的 ELBO；单调权重在 ImageNet 无引导 FID 最优
tldr_en: All common diffusion/FM losses are weighted integrals of per-noise-level ELBOs; monotonic weighting equals ELBO with Gaussian-noise data augmentation.
key_numbers: FM-OT (CFM loss) equals weighted diffusion loss with w(lambda)=exp(-lambda/2), identical to v-prediction with cosine schedule (Appendix D.3, Eq. 86)
FM-OT linear path induces Logistic log-SNR density p(lambda)=sech^2(lambda/4)/8 (Eq. 68)
ImageNet-64 eps-prediction: baseline sech(lambda/2) FID 1.55 (EDM sampler) -> sigmoid(-lambda+2) 1.46 -> adaptive + EDM-monotonic 1.44 (Table 2)
ImageNet-128 no guidance: VDM++ EDM-monotonic FID-train 1.75 / FID-eval 2.88 vs Simple Diffusion 1.91 / 3.23 (Table 3/4)
ImageNet-256 no guidance: VDM++ FID 2.40 / IS 225.3 vs Simple Diffusion 2.77 / 211.8; ImageNet-512: 2.99 / 232.2 vs 3.54 / 205.3 (Table 4)
